items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Milt Jackson, Percy Heath, all those guys could sing those solos note-for-note

ctx.x: Yeah. Later on, I found out that John Coltrane and Jimmy Heath and Jackie McLean and Sonny Rollins and a lot of other guys had been studying me from out here. Milt Jackson, Percy Heath, all those guys could sing those solos note-for-note, and I couldn't even sing them! [LAUGHS HEARTILY]

But before we get too far, I'd like to go back a little ways and talk about my first professional recording. It was with Howard McGhee's group, the original group, and we did a recording for a little record store back behind the Civic Hotel, where I was living at the time.
